text: まけると　ねえちゃんが　こわいんだ

structure.jp: ねえちゃんが　こわいんだ
structure.en: my big sis is scary, you see

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that follows'. まけると = 'if I lose'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken short form of のだ and gives an explanation of the situation. こわいんだ = 'the thing is, she's scary'.
